extraction.document_summary: AIA Premier Disability Cover is an income-protection disability insurance plan that pays monthly benefits tied to the insured’s pre-disability earnings. It provides a monthly benefit of up to 75% of existing income, paid starting from the end of a 60-day deferment period, and continues for up to 2 years; if the insured cannot perform any suitable occupation they were taught, experienced, or trained for after 2 years, payments continue until age 65 or recovery (whichever comes first). It also reimburses rehabilitation expenses up to 6x the monthly benefit per disability, pays a catastrophic disability benefit of 24x the monthly benefit (payable only once per policy), and pays a death benefit of 12x the monthly benefit for standalone policies. A payback benefit of up to 2x the monthly benefit helps during the 60-day deferment period, and premiums are waived up to age 65 or until recovery while monthly benefits continue. The brochure states exclusions apply, but does not detail them.
quality_notes: Document describes the product and key payout mechanics (monthly benefit, deferment reimbursement, rehabilitation, catastrophic disability, death benefit, and premium waiver).
Eligibility/entry age, duration of policy/renewal, and underwriting details are not stated.
Exclusions are mentioned generally, but specific exclusion conditions are not provided in the brochure text.

policies.quick_summary: Income disability insurance providing monthly payouts up to 75% of existing income, starting after a 60-day deferment period, with additional lump sum benefits for rehabilitation, catastrophic disability, and death (standalone only), plus premium waiver and deferment period reimbursement up to specified multiples of the monthly benefit, subject to stated benefit conditions and general policy exclusions/caveats not detailed in the brochure summary pages provided above 14 Feb 2024 information note within the document itself). Additionally, AIA Vitality may provide up to 15% premium discount on selected qualifying premiums.
coverage_scope: Disability due to inability to perform suitable occupation after disability begins (as described: taught, experienced or trained for)
Rehabilitation expense reimbursement (approved in writing by AIA; where appropriate certified by a physician prior to incurrence)
Catastrophic disability (lump sum, payable only once per policy)
Death benefit (12 times monthly benefit for standalone policy only)
Premium waiver while monthly benefit continues until age 65 or recovery (whichever comes first)
